reason: Coverage review against published acceptance files found explicit conditions not checked in the initial independent runner. The supplemental checks apply uniformly to all12 unmodified frozen builds.
original_results: Preserved unchanged in evaluations and already published archives; they describe the assertions actually executed then.
T1: Complete text and focus containment for every source
Research and source themes at all three widths
T2: Complete detail description, methods, dates and focus containment
Unrelated project status preservation and original note/author retention
Overview, Projects and Schedule search/filter/detail operation in both themes at all widths, both theme reloads and narrow reduced-motion operation
T3: Complete content of all three source records
Actual reading-offset preservation under mode changes
viewport_note: Initial canonical narrow captures use390×844. T2 supplemental matrix also tests390×900, matching the height explicitly named in its acceptance JSON; narrow reduced-motion uses390×844.
combination: A registered group passes finally only when its original group and any supplemental group with the same ID pass. Extra assertions are not counted as extra independent tasks or aesthetic points.
no_repairs: No participant source, frozen build, assignment or rubric is changed. Supplement outputs live in a separate directory and do not replace original archives.
interpretation: Automated functional checks retain their named scope. Readability, craft and accessibility beyond the exercised DOM/keyboard interactions require separate visual or user evidence.
